methods.acronym_expansion: CA-SpecRaGE = conditional-agreement spectral representation graph ensemble, atomic-view adaptation
assumptions: view agreement identifies a useful local geometry
methods.development_history: Built after graph studies suggested comparing several definitions of sample geometry; it learns view-agreement weights before the same LIU head.
fallbacks: fail closed with an explicit FIT_FAILED status if graph fitting or the LIU solve is invalid; no silent IU-PCR substitution
methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Treat each measurement as one view, balance near-duplicate families, and build duplicate-safe graphs that give more weight to views whose local answer neighbourhoods agree with other views before regularizing IU-PCR. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: agreement can reward duplicated nuisance; uniform, prior, global and permuted controls are required

origin.relationship: A provenance-balanced atomic conditional-agreement adaptation, not the historical LOCO-micro arm.
origin.title: CA-SpecRaGE atomic

methods.plain_summary: Treat each measurement as one view, balance near-duplicate families, and build duplicate-safe graphs that give more weight to views whose local answer neighbourhoods agree with other views before regularizing IU-PCR.

methods.acronym_expansion: Continuous L-SML (continuous Latent Spectral Meta-Learner adaptation)
assumptions: dependent measurements can be represented by approximately independent clusters
methods.development_history: The project retained score magnitude rather than median-binarizing each measurement, then applied the two-level dependence grouping to the full prepared pool.
fallbacks: no silent substitution; a near-tied grouping is retained only with an explicit degeneracy diagnostic

formula_terms.F_g: measurement block assigned to cluster g

methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Cluster measurements that appear dependent, fuse within each cluster, and fuse the cluster scores while preserving score magnitude. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: the original guarantees are for binary classifier outputs, whereas this arm uses continuous measurements

origin.relationship: Adapts the dependent-classifier L-SML hierarchy to continuous measurements.
origin.title: Unsupervised Ensemble Learning with Dependent Classifiers

methods.plain_summary: Cluster measurements that appear dependent, fuse within each cluster, and fuse the cluster scores while preserving score magnitude.

references.citation: Jaffe, Fetaya, Nadler, Jiang, and Kluger, 2016
references.title: L-SML

methods.acronym_expansion: DEEM = Deep Energy-based Ensemble Method; B3 is the project's continuous additive adapter
assumptions: a nonlinear energy model can expose a shared latent target despite measurement dependence
methods.development_history: Separated from Residual-Graph DEEM after that graph extension stopped at its synthetic gate; B3 remains the continuous graph-free candidate.
fallbacks: explicit fit-failure status; no silent replacement by IU-PCR in headline scoring

formula_terms.ell_theta_aligned: learned additive family logit after one label-free global flip toward the equal-family risk anchor

methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Fit a nonlinear energy model directly to the continuous measurement vector and convert its latent posterior into answer risk. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: our continuous B3 adapter changes the published DEEM observation model

origin.relationship: Changes the paper's hard multinomial observation model to a continuous additive, graph-free model; not a direct reproduction.
origin.title: Unsupervised Ensemble Learning Through Deep Energy-based Models

methods.plain_summary: Fit a nonlinear energy model directly to the continuous measurement vector and convert its latent posterior into answer risk.

assumptions: answers that are neighbours in gated measurement space should receive similar correctness risk
methods.development_history: Developed as the graph-based extension of the full-pool IU-PCR control; later audits showed that graph stability alone does not prove correctness alignment.
fallbacks: fail closed with an explicit FIT_FAILED status if graph construction or the projected solve is invalid; no silent IU-PCR substitution

formula_terms.L: normalized Laplacian of the DUFS-gated sample graph

methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Learn label-free soft gates that define answer similarity, build a duplicate-safe nearest-neighbour graph with a fixed row-ID tie rule, and penalize IU-PCR scores that vary sharply between neighbours. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: a stable graph may reflect length or another nuisance rather than correctness

origin.relationship: Integrates DUFS sample geometry with a Laplacian penalty inside the IU-PCR solve.
origin.title: DUFS-LIU mixed-v2

methods.plain_summary: Learn label-free soft gates that define answer similarity, build a duplicate-safe nearest-neighbour graph with a fixed row-ID tie rule, and penalize IU-PCR scores that vary sharply between neighbours.

methods.acronym_expansion: DUFS = Differentiable Unsupervised Feature Selection; L-SML = continuous latent spectral fusion
assumptions: measurements that preserve stable local sample geometry are useful for fusion
methods.development_history: Built after the advisors requested a label-free replacement for hand-picked feature subsets; this arm removes the tunable sparsity choice.
fallbacks: full-pool L-SML if fewer than three measurements survive

formula_terms.mu_j: DUFS stochastic-gate mean for measurement j

methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Use the parameter-free DUFS smoothness objective to keep measurements, then fuse the selected measurements with Continuous L-SML. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: smoothness is not the same as relevance to correctness

origin.relationship: Uses DUFS Eq. 7 selection before the project's continuous L-SML scorer.
origin.title: Differentiable Unsupervised Feature Selection based on a Gated Laplacian

methods.plain_summary: Use the parameter-free DUFS smoothness objective to keep measurements, then fuse the selected measurements with Continuous L-SML.

references.citation: Lindenbaum, Shaham, Svirsky, Peterfreund, and Kluger, 2021
references.title: DUFS

methods.acronym_expansion: DUFS = Differentiable Unsupervised Feature Selection; L-SML = continuous latent spectral fusion
assumptions: a reproducible unlabeled selection is preferable to an unstable one
methods.development_history: Developed to choose among DUFS penalties without correctness labels; the selected columns must agree across five seeds.
fallbacks: full-pool L-SML if no admissible selection keeps at least three but fewer than all measurements
methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Choose the DUFS penalty whose selected columns agree most across five random seeds, without labels, and fuse the resulting columns with Continuous L-SML. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: stability can preserve a nuisance just as reliably as correctness signal

origin.relationship: Adds a label-free seed-stability rule around DUFS, then uses continuous L-SML.
origin.title: DUFS stability selection

methods.plain_summary: Choose the DUFS penalty whose selected columns agree most across five random seeds, without labels, and fuse the resulting columns with Continuous L-SML.

references.citation: Lindenbaum, Shaham, Svirsky, Peterfreund, and Kluger, 2021
references.title: DUFS

assumptions: families, rather than individual columns, should have equal prior mass
methods.development_history: Added to prevent a provenance family with many columns from receiving more prior weight solely because it is larger.
fallbacks: equal-feature mean if no family map is available

methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.

origin.relationship: Project baseline using the frozen six-family provenance map.
origin.title: Equal-family reference floor

methods.plain_summary: Average measurements inside each available provenance family and then average the family scores, so a large family gets no extra votes.

methods.plain_summary: Average every available transformed measurement, then negate the confidence average to obtain risk.

methods.acronym_expansion: Family-NRM-A = within-cell Family Neutral Residual Mode, regime A
assumptions: a unit-variance residual mode represents a stable disagreement not already carried by IU-PCR
methods.development_history: The earlier Family-NRM result used transfer across populations. Regime A asks whether the family residual signal itself survives when every representation and rule is derived inside the target cell without donors or labels.
fallbacks: AUROC/rank-equivalent standardized IU-PCR for fewer than three non-degenerate families, an ambiguous orientation tie, or zero correction variance

formula_terms.v_star: residual-covariance eigenvector whose eigenvalue is closest to one

methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Within one target cell, remove the shared IU-PCR score from each of six family contributions, find a fixed neutral residual direction, and add a small standardized correction to IU-PCR. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: new unrun ablation; uses a manual six-family prior and the nearest-to-one rule is a heuristic

origin.relationship: New donor-free within-cell ablation of the earlier Family-NRM direction.
origin.title: Family Neutral Residual Mode

methods.plain_summary: Within one target cell, remove the shared IU-PCR score from each of six family contributions, find a fixed neutral residual direction, and add a small standardized correction to IU-PCR.

methods.acronym_expansion: IU-PCR = independent-error U-PCR variant using the full feature pool
assumptions: the same shared-target covariance model as U-PCR
methods.development_history: Frozen as the central non-graph control so every selector, dependence, or graph increment can be measured against the same PCR base.
fallbacks: fail closed when fewer than three usable measurements remain
methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Use the same covariance estimate as U-PCR but retain the full measurement pool; this is the matched non-graph control for later extensions. -> one continuous error-risk score
methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: retaining all measurements can preserve correlated nuisance

origin.relationship: Uses the independent-error covariance model and the project's full-pool two-component head.

methods.plain_summary: Use the same covariance estimate as U-PCR but retain the full measurement pool; this is the matched non-graph control for later extensions.

methods.acronym_expansion: PGRD-A = within-cell Pooled Graph-Roughness Direction, regime A
assumptions: the residual-family graph contains target-relevant direction beyond IU-PCR
methods.development_history: Developed from the Family-NRM residual representation to test whether a residual-space graph contains a useful direction without donor datasets or correctness labels.
fallbacks: AUROC/rank-equivalent standardized IU-PCR for fewer than three usable residual families or a degenerate graph, cross-gradient, or correction

methods.plain_summary: Within one cell, build a nearest-neighbour graph in residual family space and move IU-PCR in the fixed residual direction that most reduces graph roughness.

assumptions: violations of the shared-target model are sparse in the covariance matrix
methods.development_history: Added after the literature audit found that the 2022 continuation of U-PCR had already published the sparse-dependence extension.
fallbacks: fail closed with an explicit FIT_FAILED status if sparse decomposition or the PCR solve is invalid; no silent IU-PCR substitution
methods.input_operation_output: frozen mixed-v2 measurements -> Decompose measurement covariance into a low-rank shared part and sparse correlated errors before estimating the hidden target relationship. -> one continuous error-risk score

assumptions: measurement errors are pairwise uncorrelated after conditioning on one shared target
methods.development_history: Reimplemented after the feature-selection study showed that U-PCR's weak-view exclusion is itself a label-free selector; mixed-v2 now supplies the only feature orientation.
fallbacks: registered simple-average or abstention behavior, recorded per cell

formula_terms.rho_i: estimated covariance of measurement i with the hidden target

methods.inputs: One saved generation and its frozen, once-oriented mixed-v2 output-probability measurements; no label or donor data enter fitting.
limitations: covariance determines a global direction only up to sign; the frozen feature contract supplies orientation and no sign(rho) arm is added

origin.relationship: Implements U-PCR's covariance estimator with the project's documented exclusion/refit path.

methods.plain_summary: Infer each measurement's relationship to an unobserved shared target from covariance, remove measurements estimated to be weak, refit, and combine the survivors.
